content.tagline: Korean functional scalp care for hair loss, registered with MFDS and clinically studied
content.descriptor: Dr.Pelo is a Korean scalp-care brand owned by JRM Holdings: a Scalp Shampoo and Scalp Tonic registered with Korea's MFDS as functional cosmetics that help relieve hair-loss symptoms, and no-rinse Hair & Scalp Wipes.
about: Dr.Pelo is a Korean professional scalp- and hair-care brand owned by JRM Holdings. Its idea is simple: healthy, full hair starts with a healthy scalp. Dr.Pelo treats hair loss, shedding and dandruff as scalp problems — build-up, inflammation, lack of nutrients and weakened roots — and builds its routine around cleansing and exfoliating the scalp, supporting circulation and keeping the scalp at its optimal pH of 4.5–5.5.

The Dr.Pelo Scalp Shampoo and Scalp Tonic are functional cosmetics registered with Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS, formerly KFDA) for helping to relieve hair-loss symptoms. Teranova has verified both registrations in the public MFDS database: report no. 2018005699 for the shampoo and no. 2018005723 for the tonic. Their three key actives are L-menthol, salicylic acid and dexpanthenol, combined with more than ten Korean herbal extracts, including Polygonum multiflorum (hasuo) and Houttuynia cordata.

The formula has been tested clinically. In a 24-week, double-blind, placebo-controlled study at the Department of Dermatology of Korea University Ansan Hospital with 50 participants, hair density in the active group rose from 75.3 to 89.4 hairs per cm² (+18.7%) and hair thickness from 0.062 to 0.079 mm (+27.4%), with no adverse reactions. A second 24-week placebo-controlled study of the tonic formula at the P&K Skin Research Center found increased hair density in 80% of users, against 29.6% in the placebo group.

The range is completed by the Dr.Pelo Hair & Scalp Wipes: a waterless, no-rinse format with menthol for instant cooling refreshment of the hair and scalp between washes, suitable for every hair type, including braids, locs and twists. Dr.Pelo products are made in Korea, gender-neutral and designed for regular home use.

lines.name: Scalp & Hair Care
lines.note: A two-step functional routine — the Scalp Shampoo to cleanse and exfoliate the scalp and the leave-on Scalp Tonic to work on the roots — and the Hair & Scalp Wipes for a no-rinse refresh between washes.

tech.name: Three-active complex
tech.note: L-menthol cools and refreshes the scalp and helps remove build-up; salicylic acid gently exfoliates and unclogs follicles; dexpanthenol helps the scalp barrier hold moisture.

tech.name: Korean herbal extracts
tech.note: More than ten plant extracts, including Polygonum multiflorum (hasuo), Houttuynia cordata, centella, green tea and rosemary, with biotin, niacinamide and hydrolyzed keratin, collagen and silk proteins.

tech.name: Clinically studied
tech.note: Two 24-week, double-blind, placebo-controlled studies: at Korea University Ansan Hospital (50 participants) and at the P&K Skin Research Center (52 participants who completed the tonic study).

catalog_notes: A scalp shampoo registered with MFDS as a functional cosmetic that helps relieve hair-loss symptoms. L-menthol, salicylic acid and dexpanthenol cleanse build-up and refresh the scalp, while biotin, niacinamide, six hydrolyzed proteins and Korean herbal extracts care for the roots. Massage into wet hair and scalp, then rinse; recommended three times a week.

A leave-on scalp tonic registered with MFDS as a functional cosmetic that helps relieve hair-loss symptoms. Extracts of hasuo (Polygonum multiflorum) and Houttuynia cordata, 10% each, work with L-menthol, salicylic acid and dexpanthenol on the scalp between washes. Shake, apply to the scalp once a day — ideally before bed — and massage in.

Pre-moistened, no-rinse wipes for an instant cooling refresh of the hair and scalp: menthol, salicylic acid, panthenol, rosemary, green tea and centella help remove excess oil, sweat and odour. For all hair types, including braids, locs and twists — at the gym, when travelling or between washes.
